result.explanation: A panel is open only as the current selection of its group. Toggle selects an enabled panel, or closes it only for an optional group. Every event then removes disabled selections and fills empty required groups using fixed panel order.
result.mapping: Groups map to one nullable open panel; panels map to fixed-order eligibility and group membership; required groups map to automatic fallback and unsatisfied status.
result.assumptions: Unknown references are ignored. Group and panel ordering is the supplied ordering, while unsatisfied IDs are lexicographically sorted as specified.
result.holds: function holds(input,output){if(!applies(input)||!Array.isArray(output)||output.length!==input.events.length)return false;var c=input.config,gs=c.groups,ps=c.panels,e={},r={},i,j;for(i=0;i<gs.length;i++){e[gs[i].id]=gs[i].required;r[gs[i].id]=null}function norm(){for(j=0;j<ps.length;j++){var p=ps[j];if(r[p.group]===p.id&&!p.enabled)r[p.group]=null}for(i=0;i<gs.length;i++)if(e[gs[i].id]&&r[gs[i].id]===null)for(j=0;j<ps.length;j++)if(ps[j].group===gs[i].id&&ps[j].enabled){r[gs[i].id]=ps[j].id;break}}function want(){var o={open:{},expanded:[],unsatisfied:[]};for(i=0;i<gs.length;i++)o.open[gs[i].id]=r[gs[i].id];for(j=0;j<ps.length;j++)if(r[ps[j].group]===ps[j].id)o.expanded.push(ps[j].id);for(i=0;i<gs.length;i++)if(e[gs[i].id]&&r[gs[i].id]===null)o.unsatisfied.push(gs[i].id);o.unsatisfied.sort();return o}norm();for(i=0;i<input.events.length;i++){var x=input.events[i],p=null;for(j=0;j<ps.length;j++)if(ps[j].id===x.id){p=ps[j];break}if(x.type==='toggle'&&p&&p.enabled){if(r[p.group]===p.id){if(!e[p.group])r[p.group]=null}else r[p.group]=p.id}else if(x.type==='enabled'&&p)p.enabled=x.value;else if(x.type==='close'&&e[x.group]===false)r[x.group]=null;else if(x.type==='mode'&&e[x.group]!==undefined)e[x.group]=x.required;norm();var z=want(),q=output[i];if(JSON.stringify(z)!==JSON.stringify(q))return false}return true}
